subject: public.undefined duplicate migration tracking
decision: Removed only the two known records duplicated in canonical public.pgmigrations, with no CASCADE. Guard refuses unknown columns/records. No HR rows removed. Programmatic migration runner must explicitly set migrationsTable=pgmigrations.

subject: core.documents.kind / doc_type
decision: kind identifies generic file category; doc_type is the existing catalog FK. New employee uploads use kind=employee_document and doc_type=class. Joining files are recognized by doc_type, and legacy branch rows fall back to kind. Reuse SHA256 for retry identity, expiry/status/ownership for lifecycle; no new business columns.

subject: doc.types.retention_class and field-class authority
decision: statutory_id class requires employee.statutory_ids.read; health requires explicit employee.medical.read; configured compensation classes require employee.compensation.read, in addition to vault/employee scope. Default medical authority goes only to the existing super-admin catch-all. Existing identity aliases remain supported.

subject: att.shifts.session2_start/end, break_paid, ot_start_offset_minutes, att.swipe_events.direction
decision: Shared windows connect these existing fields to actual day computation, AR/OD halves and final biometric completeness. Separate-session gaps are excluded. Explicit IN/OUT outrank unknown-direction fallback. No configured shift on a working day fails closed. Attendance presence fractions/payable policy unchanged. Correct net late/early minutes to docs04 grace formula; tests hand-check 09:25 minus 09:00 minus10 grace=15 minutes. Catalog API now preserves/persists micro-fields and rejects conflicting windows; rule validation rejects overlapping ranges.

subject: att.shift_swaps snapshot and workflow transaction
decision: Both employee locks are acquired in order before request locks. Existing workflow payload stores authoritative shift/week-off snapshots; no added table columns. Approval rechecks current roster, active approver and roster-write scope for both people. Generic forged creation is reserved. Old requests without a snapshot fail closed and need withdrawal/recreation. Independent-connection concurrency/UAT proof is still required.

subject: pay.it_slabs has no current direct application consumer; tax engine embeds slab arrays
decision: Keep the fiscal-year/regime table as a required configuration model, not as proof it is connected. Decide the canonical effective tax-rule source, freeze it per run, connect calculation and configuration consistently, verify all statutory facts and add hand-computed goldens before any money edit. Mandatory independent payroll human review. No money formula was edited in this increment.

subject: schema-only joining master/declaration/medical tables
decision: Addresses, education, certifications, experience, statutory profile, nominations/declarations and medical records have documented joining-form purposes. Current production-table references are missing beyond type declarations in this snapshot. Complete approved form validation, atomic conversion, scoped read/write, correction/versioning and export paths; do not claim these complete or delete them as unused.

subject: structured addresses versus legacy text; physical attributes versus medical snapshot
decision: Migration defines legacy address text as derived read copies. Implement one authoritative write path; never two editable sources. Clarify master personal fields versus medical questionnaire measurements and their restricted purpose before collection; do not silently synchronize/duplicate sensitive values.

subject: 14 excluded MFA fields with existing records
decision: MFA remains disabled and excluded. Two legacy tables contain 32 enrollment rows and 320 recovery-code rows. No secret/hash values were read. Do not drop nonempty credential/history data based on absence of code references. Establish provenance and permitted retirement/archive before a destructive migration.

subject: privacy tables and purpose-stamped access events
decision: Approved added scope gives these tables a purpose. Schema presence is not implementation: recover scoped handlers, immutable consent/access events, employee history and retention/rights workflows. A current consent projection may coexist with immutable events only with atomic updates and a tested rebuild; do not introduce another mutable source of truth.

subject: Separate penalty snapshot preserves actual first/second-half attendance
decision: Sponsor confirmed preserving attendance facts. One justified snapshot column holds exact matched rules and observed net minutes; compatibility boolean is constrained, not another editable authority or quantity. NULL historical/not evaluated does not fabricate old rule data. DB validators and existing lock triggers protect findings. Configurable rule arrays reject ambiguity. No payroll stacking/cap/consumption formula is inferred.

subject: Documented raw source attributes and document checklist limits are not fully consumed
decision: Keep specified Kent shift_label/remarks/permission_reason/signed_by and ATT-14 location/device evidence, but current RawSwipe does not transport them. Real source contract and tests remain required. Device expected_hourly_swipes has no current service consumer. Document mandatory_for/joining_checklist/max_files model requirements; current vault does not prove collection coverage or enforce checklist file limits. Do not delete required planned fields or claim these flows complete.
